CRM service request themes

3,994 cases from 2026-01-01 to 2026-08-31 across CRM Core, Profile, Messaging, and Automations. Jira mapping uses 327 open board items created on or after 2026-01-01.

How this report was built

Source: Google Sheet All Servicenow service requests from 2026-01-01 (ID 1cmz5PB6LO65AJWC1PU_vdFJbc_2pZ6ykPuVUkrCbAF8). No other sources used. Cases in the window: 26,499. In the four areas: 4,036. Excluded as Spam (8) or Duplicate (34).

Area comes from U_SUB_PRODUCT, then U_COMPONENT, then PRODUCT_EXPERIENCE_PRODUCT. Theme is the first matching phrase on the Short description. No match stays Unclassified.

Jira is the CRM Core Board (board 1091), read-only. 3,724 Initiative, Epic, and Story items. Metadata excluded: 92. Done removed: 1,988. Blocked removed: 9. Created before 2026-01-01 removed: 3,222. The board holds CRM - Core work only.

How Jira items were mapped to themes
  • Each theme has its own phrase list. An Initiative, Epic or Story maps to a theme when its title contains one of those phrases; the matched phrase is shown next to the item. One item can map to more than one theme.
  • A Story whose own title does not match inherits its parent Epic's themes (shown as via parent epic).
  • Unmatched parents are shown as context only so the Initiative › Epic › Story path stays visible.
  • Engineering-only and internal-analytics items (tooling, observability, refactors, tech debt, framework upgrades, test plumbing, business-review metrics), judged by the item's or its parent epic's title (62 items), are not mapped, except to the Performance and Security themes.
  • Done items, Blocked items, and items created before 2026-01-01 are removed. A 2026 Story or Epic whose parent was removed sits under a label naming that reason, and Stories do not inherit themes from a removed Epic.
  • Metadata items are excluded (see the header). Non-actionable cases are not mapped; Unclassified cases are shown as a count only.

708 open SUP (support) tickets created from 2026-01-01 to 2026-10-30 whose Product Experience is one of the four CRM areas. 3,159 of the 3,867 fetched tickets are in Jira's Done status category (3,099 Done, 54 In Prod, 6 Closed) and are not shown or counted. Each area shows its open SUP ticket count, the themes found in the ticket titles, and the non-SUP Jira Initiatives, Epics and Stories associated with each theme.

How this tab was built
  • Source: Jira project SUP, read only, fetched on 2026-10-30. Queries (results were paged and the stored count equals the Jira total for each query):
    • CRM Core: project = SUP AND created >= "2026-01-01" AND "Product Experience: Product2[Dropdown]" = "Recruiter Experience (RX) - CRM - Core" ORDER BY key ASC
    • Profile: project = SUP AND created >= "2026-01-01" AND created < "2026-06-01" AND "Product Experience: Product2[Dropdown]" = "Recruiter Experience (RX) - CRM - Profile" ORDER BY key ASC
    • Profile: project = SUP AND created >= "2026-06-01" AND "Product Experience: Product2[Dropdown]" = "Recruiter Experience (RX) - CRM - Profile" ORDER BY key ASC
    • Messaging: project = SUP AND created >= "2026-01-01" AND created < "2026-06-01" AND "Product Experience: Product2[Dropdown]" = "Recruiter Experience (RX) - CRM - Messaging and Campaigns" ORDER BY key ASC
    • Messaging: project = SUP AND created >= "2026-06-01" AND "Product Experience: Product2[Dropdown]" = "Recruiter Experience (RX) - CRM - Messaging and Campaigns" ORDER BY key ASC
    • Automations: project = SUP AND created >= "2026-01-01" AND "Product Experience: Product2[Dropdown]" = "Recruiter Experience (RX) - CRM - Automation" ORDER BY key ASC
  • SUP tickets in Jira's Done status category (statuses Done, In Prod and Closed) are removed before classification. Open tickets in To Do or In Progress statuses, including Confirm Resolution and Reporter Review, are kept. Jira links are taken from open tickets only.
  • Theme: the first matching phrase rule on the SUP ticket title (skill 01_product-os/skills/sup-ticket-themes). Descriptions are not used: on a sample, most description-only matches were wrong. A title with no matching phrase stays Unclassified; no label is forced.
  • Associated Jira items (non-SUP), two methods shown separately: Linked from SUP lists PHEM Initiatives, Epics and Stories that a SUP ticket in the theme links to in Jira; Matched by title lists PHEM Initiatives, Epics and Stories with the same Product Experience value, created on or after 2026-01-01, whose title contains one of the theme's phrases (a Story with no match inherits its parent Epic's themes).
  • Done items, Blocked items and items created before 2026-01-01 are removed from both methods and counted. Engineering-only items (tooling, refactors, upgrades, test plumbing) are not matched by title, except to the performance and security themes.
  • Email addresses and phone numbers in titles are shown as xxxxxx. Ticket descriptions, reporters and assignees are not shown.
  • Limits: title matching misses Jira items worded differently from the theme phrases, and few SUP tickets carry a Jira link, so an empty cell means no evidence was found, not that no work exists.
